layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Gallimimus speed morphology
features: A slender, athletic clay Gallimimus in a full sprint
Extremely long, powerful drumstick-shaped hind legs
Standing on its tiptoes with elongated foot bones
Small, aerodynamic head and a long, stiff balancing tail
Wispy clay 'motion streaks' trailing behind the dinosaur to show fast movement
Puffs of clay 'dust' kicking up from the ground
layer_3_action.action: A dynamic side-profile action shot. The dinosaur is mid-stride with both feet off the ground. The background has a slight motion blur to emphasize the 'Fast Runner' superpower. No text.
